sources.title: CogAgent: An open-sourced VLM-based GUI Agent - GitHub
sources.snippet: CogAgent-9B-20241220 model is based on GLM-4V-9B, a bilingual open-source VLM base model. Through data collection and optimization, multi-stage training, and strategy improvements, CogAgent-9B-20241220 achieves significant advancements in GUI perception, inference prediction accuracy, action space completeness, and generalizability across tasks.
